facts.text: Deborah mentioned that Bali was a place where she found peace and was great for yoga.

evidence.quote: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.

facts.text: Jolene expressed interest in trying yoga on the beach and mentioned she would give it a go.

evidence.quote: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!

facts.text: Deborah encouraged Jolene to let her know how her experience with yoga on the beach went.

evidence.quote: Let me know how it goes. Enjoy it!
